arguments.question: For ANET, MU, META and NVDA, examine the latest available company filings/primary materials and provide neutral 21/63-session thesis inputs: latest operating trajectory, disclosed guidance or demand/capex indicators, key company-specific upside/downside catalysts, and any dated earnings-per-share/share-count fields usable for explicitly assumption-labeled valuation scenarios. For QQQ, provide dated holdings/profile look-through only if available. Cite evidence IDs; stop after the most recent material filing/primary release per issuer and the seeded QQQ profile/holdings.
arguments.decision_impact: Separates company-specific earnings/catalyst risk from broad technology-factor exposure and supplies supported inputs for conditional scenario valuation.
